description: This file defines a speech processing pipeline for live audio input, utilizing Apple's AVFoundation and Speech frameworks. It includes data structures for speech segments and error handling, and an actor that manages the speech recognition process, including audio capture, analysis, and transcription. The pipeline handles authorization, audio format compatibility, and streams recognized speech segments.

classes.name: SpeechSegment
classes.description: A data structure representing a segment of recognized speech, including the transcribed text and a flag indicating if it is the final segment.

classes.name: SpeechPipelineError
classes.description: An enumeration listing possible errors in the speech processing pipeline, such as authorization denial and unavailable analyzers or transcribers.

classes.name: SpeechPipeline
classes.description: An actor managing the live speech recognition pipeline, including audio input, analysis, and transcription, with methods to start and stop the process.

classes.name: UnsafeBuffer
classes.description: A private nested struct wrapping AVAudioPCMBuffer for thread-safe buffer handling.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the speech recognition process, setting up audio capture, analysis, and returning a stream of recognized speech segments.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the speech recognition process, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: handleBuffer
methods.description: Handles incoming audio buffers, converting them to the target format and passing them into the analysis pipeline.

methods.name: requestAuthorizationIfNeeded
methods.description: Requests speech recognition authorization if not already granted.
